AT&T._comment: Bangalore site, one counter (themes Mon/Tue/Fri = mix, Wed = biryani, Thu = north). Deliberately NOT configured as a rule: 'daily curd except on biryani day it is raita' is already what `curd_raita_logic` (the city ruleset's curd_side rule) does — biryani/pulao days get a raita, every other day a plain curd — so restating it here would be a second copy of the same logic that can drift.

rules._comment: 'soya or kofta once a week' — one rule, not two, because the client offered them as alternatives. Soya is selected on key_ingredient (98 Bangalore rows across rice/salad/starter/veg_dry/veg_gravy) and kofta on its own flag (32 veg gravies); scoping to a slot would narrow the choice the client left open.
rules.name: att_soya_or_kofta_1x
